prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a pet template or start custom creation.", "Pet Types"]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Pet", "Learn keyboard shortcuts, screen placement, and hide settings."]
3: ["Practice Playing While We Load", "Try feeding and calling your pet in this sandbox preview."]
4: ["Log in with your original account to instantly restore your existing pets and progress."]
5: []
6: ["Choose Your Onboarding Speed", "Pick Quick Adopt (2 mins) or Custom Studio (5 mins). You can always tweak your pet later.", "Preset pets can be customized anytime in settings."]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Claim your companion certificate and unlock an exclusive desktop badge!", "Official Companion Badge"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Look at the bottom corner of your screen. If you don't see your pet, click below to bring it to front.", "Locate Pet on Screen", "Ping Pet Position"]
9: ["Preview Custom Pet Render", "Upload photos to immediately see how your desktop pet will look.", "Upload Photo"]

verdicts.problem: Promotes free extras or exclusive items
Requests personal photos/information from the user
